items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee lists many musicians he played with in a specific ensemble (Watrous, Rosolino, etc.), but Jon Faddis is mentioned later by the interviewer as a surprise guest, with no indication the interviewee knew him personally or played with him.

ctx.x: Well, the trombones was -- were Watrous, Rosolino, Carl Fontana, Vic Dickinson, myself, Al Grey, George Masso. And the trumpets were -- trumpets were Clark Terry, and Ruby Braff, Pee Wee Erwin, Joe Wilder, and Jon

Fattis, somebody else. There's so many -- there were 51 guys up there, you know. And a lot of saxophone players. Zoot Sims, Al Cohn, Budd Johnson, Benny Carter. I know I'm leaving some out. Phil Woods. There's some amazing guys up there. And Buddy DeFranco was up there. And Buddy Tate. And what's that guy who used to arrange for Basie? Tenor man. Ernie Wilkins.
